title: A nineteen-operation decoder for the binary repetition code

claims.statement: For the stated 1000-bit repetition encoder on 2000 independent BSC(1/10) uses and its fixed nineteen-operation decoder in proof.md, the average block error for a uniform message is at most the submitted rational B, computed by rounding 1-(9/10)^192*2^-808 upward to a multiple of 10^-255.
The stated bsc-ops-v1 decoder uses exactly W=19 primitives for every received word, with W<=2^(531/125).

experiments.purpose: Recompute the reduced exact error fraction and recheck the fixed operation count and output layout on sample inputs.
